# Max Pergola

> Max Pergola supplies factory-direct aluminum louvered pergola kits for residential projects in the United States. Product pages lead with U.S. customary dimensions and include metric references for drawings and production.

Current shipping: orders are quoted factory-direct from Chongqing under Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) terms to a confirmed U.S. destination. Max Pergola plans to begin Los Angeles fulfillment for select in-stock standard SKUs in July 2027. The written project quote controls pricing, design criteria, availability, shipping terms, and ship-from location.

## Products

- [Aluminum pergola kits](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-kits/): Compare seven nominal footprints from 10 × 10 ft through 13 × 19 ft; choose the roof package, layout, finish, and factory-prepared accessories; and create a configuration SKU for a written quote.
- [Louvered pergola kits](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-kits/louvered/): Compare manual and motorized aluminum louvers, adjustable shade, integrated drainage, lighting preparation, and project scope.

## Planning guides

- [Pergola lighting ideas](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-lighting-ideas/): Ambient, task, accent, and circulation-light planning for dining, cooking, lounge, and walkway zones.
- [Pergola installation](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-installation/): Complete project scope from permits and foundations through frame, roof, electrical work, testing, and inspection.
- [Pergola cost guide](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-cost/): Budget the kit, delivery, unloading, foundations, labor, electrical work, permits, taxes, and inspections.
- [DIY pergola guide](https://maxpergola.com/diy-pergola/): Jobsite, footing, anchor, delivery, frame, louvered-roof, drainage, and final-inspection checklist.
- [Backyard pergola ideas](https://maxpergola.com/backyard-pergola-ideas/): Six residential layouts for outdoor dining, kitchens, pool decks, small patios, and evening lounges.
- [Pergola vs gazebo](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-vs-gazebo/): Comparison of roof type, shade control, rain coverage, footings, maintenance, and common backyard uses.

## Trade partners

- [Partner program](https://maxpergola.com/partner-program/): Qualification, modeled trade-pricing ceilings, project registration, display support, delivery planning, and application for dealers, fabricators, installers, and builders.
